items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: Jack Parr actually used to play. Yeah, he used to be often on Jack Parr. But he was playing on that thing. No, I've never seen him play nothing.

ctx.x: Sure enough. Old baggity-pants, please. Yeah, Charlie Weaver. I've seen him on many programs.
Jack Parr actually used to play. Yeah, he used to be often on Jack Parr. But he was playing on that thing. No, I've never seen him play nothing. No, but he was playing alone.
